response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an experienced software developer with a strong technical background and diverse project experience. However, his senior-level expertise and focus on languages/tools outside the core requirements (Java, agile, insurance sector) make him an overqualified candidate for this junior role. His profile suggests he may seek more advanced responsibilities than the position offers.
strengths: Extensive software development experience across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, AI) and technologies
Proven leadership in open-source projects (e.g., GISCollective) and community contributions (workshops, talks)
Strong problem-solving skills demonstrated through diverse technical challenges and innovation
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level position, which may lead to early turnover
Limited direct experience with Java (core requirement) and insurance sector projects
German language skills are basic, which may hinder client collaboration
